QUOTE: "`check_approval` only consults the allow list." and "The allow list only skips the approval step. It never overrides deny, schema, or tier checks."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list only skips approval rather than granting execution, and places its use in check_approval (tool_executor.cpp:161) while deny sits in ServerManager::execute in server_manager.cpp, a different file.
